verdict.rationale: Companies House publishes a dedicated API versioning guide, but it describes only a *proposed* approach. All existing resources are held 'as is' at 'version 0' while the API remains in beta, so there is no real multi-version scheme yet. The pack contains nothing on deprecation timelines or sunset notices. Missing for 10: actual versioned API releases, a documented deprecation policy with timelines/notice periods, independent corroboration of version stability.
